title: Yellow Crispy Korean Doenjang Flatbread
description: A pungent and crispy Korean-inspired flatbread featuring doenjang, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly snack or lunch, cooked to a crispy perfection on a slate-tile vessel
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, salt, and yeast.
Gradually add the water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a slate-tile vessel or a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Brush the tops with sesame oil and spread a small amount of doenjang on each circle.
Sprinkle chopped scallions on top of the doenjang.
Cook the flatbreads for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are crispy and golden brown.
Serve the flatbreads hot and enjoy.
